description: This file provides the implementation of the EntityType interface, specifically the DefaultEntityType class that encapsulates an entity type value, provides methods for creation, comparison, and string operations, and ensures immutability.

classes.name: DefaultEntityType
classes.description: An immutable class implementing EntityType that encapsulates a string value representing an entity type and provides comparison and string manipulation methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultEntityType, validating the input value is not null or empty.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to provide equality comparison based on the internal value.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this DefaultEntityType with another EntityType based on string value.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the entity type string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the value from start to end.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity type.
